name: Zhou Yiran
bio: Zhou Yiran is a Chinese actress.

credits.title: Gezhi Town
credits.overview: A group of Chinese refugees and straggler soldiers, led by a machinist, defend their mountain town, "Gezhi," against a surprise attack by Japanese reconnaissance troops in a desperate fight using civilian ingenuity against a trained military force.

credits.title: Enjoy Yourself
credits.overview: Luo Yu and Bai Hui's marriage broke down due to the accidental death of their child. While waiting for the divorce certificate, the two were involved in a family dispute case as a lawyer and a doctor. As the divorce and the lawsuit progressed, the two had a new understanding of marriage and life.

credits.title: Across the Furious Sea
credits.overview: A murder case reveals unknown secrets of the killer and the victim.

credits.title: Be My Family
credits.overview: In order to claim the arrears, two laid-off workers took temporary care of Qianqian, the daughter of the debtor, but they didn't expect Qianqian to have an accident.

credits.title: Flaming Cloud
credits.overview: Cursed by mischievous deities, Sangui Wang plunges those he kisses into a deep sleep.

credits.overview: Come skip through time and interchange between reality and imagination to witness the silliest and sweetest time-travel romance!  Chen Shi Jie accidentally returns to the past. credits.title: I Am Your Mom
credits.overview: When Zhao Xiaoyi passes the entrance exam to enroll as an art student, it’s more to her than a chance to pursue her creative dreams. After years of close supervision at home, it also means freedom and independence. Away at school at last, a lonelier Zhao finds there may be more to miss at home than there is to discover
